style: Flat-vector UI illustration with a restrained 'terminal noir' art direction. Palette: deep charcoal #0E1116 background, panel #161B23, hairline borders #2A313C, off-white text #E6E9EF, muted grey #8B93A1, and exactly four signal accents used sparingly: amber #F5A623, coral #FF6B4A, mint #34D399, sky blue #4C9AFF. Crisp geometry, generous negative space, 1px hairline details, subtle inner glow on the signal dots only. No gradients that smear, no 3D bevels, no lens flare, no photorealism, no human faces, no text clutter. Typeface feel: geometric sans for headings, monospace for data. Composition centred, high contrast, readable when scaled down.
